article.title: Causal Inference, Accountability, and Governance in AI-Assisted Decisions

paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence increasingly recommends decisions in hiring, lending, marketing, and public services. These systems can recognize patterns in large datasets, but predictive accuracy does not establish that a recommended action will cause a desirable outcome. A model may identify customers likely to purchase without identifying which customers would purchase only because they received an advertisement. This distinction matters when organizations allocate limited resources. Responsible governance requires more than checking whether predictions match historical observations. It requires specifying the intervention, identifying evidence for its causal effect, and assigning accountability for the final decision. A prediction is a statement about what may happen; a causal claim concerns what would change because an action was taken.
paragraphs.zh: AI 越來越常為招募、貸款、行銷與公共服務提出建議，但預測準確不代表行動會造成理想結果。模型可能找出本來就會買的客戶，卻無法找出因廣告才購買者。治理必須定義介入、因果證據與決策責任。預測是可能發生什麼；因果則是採取行動會改變什麼。
paragraphs.ja: AIは採用や融資、販売促進の判断を支援しますが、予測精度と因果効果は異なります。元から購入する人と広告によって購入する人は同じではありません。介入の定義、証拠、責任者が必要です。

paragraphs.en: Consider a marketing team that predicts who will sign a contract within thirty days. The highest-scoring customers may already intend to purchase. Messaging them could produce an impressive conversion rate while creating few additional contracts. A randomized control group can help estimate incremental impact by comparing outcomes among customers who received the message with otherwise comparable customers who did not. The design still requires appropriate implementation and interpretation. The key lesson is that selecting customers with high predicted outcomes is not identical to selecting customers who will respond positively to treatment. An organization should measure the value created by its intervention rather than merely celebrating the raw rate among selected customers.
paragraphs.zh: 行銷團隊預測三十天內誰會簽約時，高分客戶可能原本就有意購買。即使訊息組轉換率高，新增合約也可能少。隨機對照組有助比較有無訊息的結果，估計增量效果。選出高預測分數的人，不等於選出會因介入而改變行為的人。
paragraphs.ja: 三十日以内の成約を予測しても、高得点者は元から購入する可能性があります。無作為な対照群と比較し、追加効果を評価します。予測値の高さと介入への反応は異なります。

paragraphs.en: Causal inference begins by defining the treatment, outcome, population, and observation period. The vague question 'Does AI improve performance?' combines many different mechanisms and is difficult to test. A more useful question asks whether a specific recommendation increases completed applications in a defined group over the following month. Analysts must consider confounding variables that influence both treatment assignment and the outcome. Historical comparisons may be distorted by seasonality, changing eligibility rules, or customer motivation. Statistical adjustment can reduce some biases but cannot guarantee that every relevant confounder has been observed. Conclusions should therefore describe the assumptions on which they depend.
paragraphs.zh: 因果推論先定義處置、結果、母體與觀察期間。「AI 是否改善績效」過於模糊。更好的問題是特定建議是否提高某群體下月申請完成數。須考慮同時影響介入與結果的混淆變數。季節、資格與客戶動機會扭曲歷史比較，統計調整也無法保證排除所有偏差。
paragraphs.ja: 因果推論では処置、結果、対象、期間を定義します。季節や顧客の意欲などの交絡因子に注意し、統計調整にも限界があることを明示します。

paragraphs.en: Even randomized experiments require careful implementation. If control participants accidentally receive the intervention, the comparison becomes difficult to interpret. If a model changes halfway through the experiment, the treatment may no longer be consistent. A small sample can produce an estimate too imprecise to distinguish a useful improvement from random variation. Teams should define their primary outcome before examining results, document exclusions, and report uncertainty. They should avoid presenting only the most favorable subgroup. An experiment is a disciplined process for learning about the world, not a mechanism for ensuring that management's preferred strategy appears successful. A negative result can be valuable when it prevents expensive mistakes.
paragraphs.zh: 隨機實驗仍需謹慎：對照組意外接受介入、模型中途變更或樣本不足都會影響解釋。應事先定義主要結果、記錄排除條件並報告不確定性，避免只挑有利子群。實驗是學習工具，不是保證偏好策略成功的手段。負面結果也能避免昂貴錯誤。
paragraphs.ja: 無作為化実験でも対照群への介入混入、途中のモデル変更、標本不足に注意します。主要指標と除外条件を事前に決め、不確実性を報告します。否定的な結果にも価値があります。

paragraphs.en: Accountability becomes complicated when humans rely heavily on automated recommendations. A manager may believe that numerical outputs are objective, while developers may assume that managers will catch harmful suggestions. When responsibilities are unclear, critical risks can fall between the two groups. Governance should identify who owns the model, who approves deployment, who monitors outcomes, and who can suspend use. Human oversight must be meaningful: reviewers need information, time, expertise, and authority to challenge recommendations. A nominal approval button is not effective control when the reviewer cannot understand the evidence. Organizations cannot transfer moral and operational responsibility to a computer merely by automating part of the workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 人類高度依賴自動建議時，責任容易模糊。主管以為數字客觀，開發者以為主管會發現問題，風險可能落空。應指定模型所有者、部署核准者、監控者與停用權限。人工監督需要資訊、時間、專業與質疑權。形式上的核准按鈕不能取代實質控管。
paragraphs.ja: 自動提案に依存すると責任が曖昧になります。所有者、承認者、監視担当者、停止権限を決めます。人間の監督には情報、時間、専門性、異議を唱える権限が必要です。

paragraphs.en: Fairness requires examining consequences, not only accuracy. A model can have similar predictive quality across groups while producing unequal outcomes when its recommendations are acted upon. Some groups may receive more beneficial interventions, while others bear higher error costs or have fewer opportunities to appeal. Aggregate performance metrics can conceal these differences. Organizations should examine the distribution of benefits and harms while respecting privacy and applicable law. Different fairness criteria may conflict, so the chosen standard should be documented rather than presented as a universal mathematical truth. People affected by consequential decisions should receive explanations that are understandable and meaningful to them.
paragraphs.zh: 公平不只看準確率。模型即使在不同群體準確率相似，採用建議後仍可能造成不平等。某些人獲得較多有益介入，其他人承擔較高錯誤成本或缺少申訴管道。總體指標可能掩蓋差異。應考慮利益與傷害分配、隱私及法律，並記錄公平標準的取捨。
paragraphs.ja: 公平性は精度だけでは判断できません。集団によって利益や誤りの負担、異議申立ての機会が異なる可能性があります。指標の選択理由を明示し、影響を受ける人へ説明します。

paragraphs.en: Monitoring after deployment is essential because environments change. Customer preferences, regulations, products, and data pipelines may drift away from development conditions. A model can remain technically operational while its recommendations become less useful or more harmful. Monitoring should track input quality, predictive performance, decisions taken, and downstream outcomes. Teams need thresholds for investigation and procedures for rollback or suspension. They should distinguish data pipeline failures from genuine changes in behavior because the remedies differ. Periodic reviews should include domain experts and operational staff, not only engineers. A dashboard is useful only when someone is empowered to respond to the warning signals it displays.
paragraphs.zh: 部署後環境會變，顧客、法規、產品及資料流程可能漂移。模型仍正常運作，建議卻可能失效。應監控輸入品質、預測、決策與後續結果，設定調查、回滾或停用門檻。資料故障與真實行為變化須分開處理。儀表板只有在有人有權回應警訊時才有用。
paragraphs.ja: 導入後は顧客、規制、製品、データが変化します。入力品質、予測、判断、実際の結果を監視し、調査や停止の基準を定めます。警告に対応する権限も必要です。

paragraphs.en: The strongest governance framework connects technical evidence with organizational choices. Before deployment, teams define the intended use, causal assumptions, measurable benefits, foreseeable harms, and escalation procedures. During operation, they record decisions and investigate deviations. When evidence changes, they update the model or the business process instead of defending an outdated design. The objective is not to eliminate uncertainty, which is impossible, but to make uncertainty visible and manageable. AI-assisted decisions deserve trust when organizations can explain why an action was taken, what evidence supported it, how its effects were measured, and who is responsible for correcting mistakes. Technical sophistication alone is not an adequate substitute for such explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 治理應連結技術證據與組織選擇。部署前定義用途、因果假設、效益、傷害與升級程序；運作中記錄決策、調查偏差。證據改變時應更新模型或流程。目標是管理不確定，而非假裝消除它。能解釋行動理由、證據、效果與修正責任，AI 決策才值得信任。
paragraphs.ja: 強い統治は技術的証拠と組織判断を結びつけます。導入前に用途、仮定、利益、害、対応手順を定義し、運用中に記録と検証を続けます。不確実性を管理し、誤りを修正する責任を明確にします。
